Skip duplicate articles, Articles with links or titles identical to existing articles are ignored
Articles with links or titles identical to existing articles are ignored
Generate extra unique IDs, Only enable for feeds with bad IDs
Only enable for feeds with bad IDs

One rule per line, written as FieldName=pattern. Available fields are Title, URL, Author, Tag and Content. The pattern is a regular expression which matches anywhere in the field; start it with (?i) to ignore case. Rules take effect on the next fetch and do not affect already-saved articles.
Matching articles are never downloaded. Unlike the blocklist, this cannot be undone: removing a rule does not bring back articles which were already skipped.
If any allow rule is set, only matching articles are downloaded. A Tag rule is skipped for articles which have no tags, so a feed without tags is not emptied by a Tag rule alone.
